props.title: Artifact craft
props.note: An interactive authoring example. Check behavior as well as appearance.

props.text: A guide should make its claims inspectable. This example explains the authoring pattern; it is not an independent product benchmark.
A field guide helps a reader move from orientation to a useful decision. Give each chapter one job, make the evidence easy to inspect, and let controls change a real answer.

props.title: How to use this guide
props.text: Choose a chapter in the rail or use the next/previous links. Explore the map, tick the review checklist, then filter the caveats. Your choices stay while you move between chapters.

props.label: From authoring to a reader
props.caption: Select a layer to see its responsibility. Color follows the selected layer.

props.text: Start with the reader's task. Then choose the blocks and the smallest interaction that helps them complete it. Keep content in the document and behavior in published contracts.
